children: Retail sales in South Korea declined by 2.4% month-over-month in July 2026, reversing a 2.7% increase in the previous month.
The decrease was largely driven by lower sales of durable goods, particularly passenger cars and home appliances.
On a year-on-year basis, retail activity dropped by 0.8% in July, slipping from a downwardly revised 3.9% rise in the preceding period.

As a key gauge of private consumption, the latest figures suggest household spending lost momentum at the start of the third quarter, pointing to weaker domestic demand and could weigh on economic growth.

title: South Korea Retail Sales Decline in July
